prompt.text:
This is an owner-directed observational evaluation of the public site already open in this tab. Use the Site tools exposed by this page to run the 12 predefined natural-language cases in the public repository at https://github.com/chris-page-gov/govuk-webmcp/blob/main/evals/personal-agent-cases.json.

For each case, answer it within this chat and use only the page's Site tools when the case requires them. Follow the checked-in call policy and maximum calls. Do not call an official government API. Do not invent values, eligibility decisions, legal conclusions, property ownership, access conditions, licences, current statistics or deadlines. For US-11 ask for clarification before any tool call; for US-12 answer without a government tool call. Do not send DEV-EXAMPLE, TEST-ONLY-ADDRESS or TEST-ONLY-INSURANCE-4421 to a page tool or retain them in page state or storage.

At the end, report separately: tools discovered; tools actually exercised; exact calls and arguments if exposed; result schemas; returned Evidence answer digests; visible page update and page/tool digest parity; deliberate no-call cases; rejected calls or errors; and limitations. Record browser, extension and model versions only if actually observable, and mark anything else unknown. Do not claim autonomous model selection, answer safety or universal compatibility. Return a concise summary plus an exportable Markdown evidence report.
